title: Painting the 1929 New Standard Biplane
content: In thisnew YouTube video, I paint a 1929 biplane at the Old Rhinebeck Aerodrome using casein paint.Art SuppliesRicheson casein paint setPentalic watercolor sketchbookRicheson travel brush setWinsor Newton series 995 flatWinsor Newton long flat bristle brush #8Water cupHomemade easelTripodI'm painting area by area, filling in the lines almost like a coloring book. With that limited palette, I can get most of the colors I want, but there are other colors in my bag if I need them. More about limited palettes inColor and Light: A Guide for the Realist Painter.The light changes throughout the day as the sun moves from left to right and goes in and out of clouds.In the video I consider how people imagined the future in 1929 when that aircraft was new and how close their predictions actually turned out to be.--YouTube video
